name: murf-livekit-starter
description: Voice AI agent starter powered by Murf Falcon TTS and LiveKit Agents

scripts.setup: cd backend && uv sync && cd ../frontend && pnpm install
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run python src/agent.py dev
scripts.lint: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && cd ../frontend && pnpm lint
scripts.format: cd backend && uv run ruff format . && cd ../frontend && pnpm format
